mesh_state.addressing: Earth4D spatial and temporal hash fields
mesh_state.rule: Every modality writes to this state; raw modalities do not bypass it.

writes.routing: signal_lens assigns each modality to one scientific fiber
writes.composition: gated residual writes followed by cross-scale and cross-lens exchange
writes.biological_state: SpeciesGraph refines species state through the dated phylogeny before its mesh write

reader.operation: task-conditioned sparse reads over cells, scales, and lenses, then per-variable decoding

masking.objective: reconstruct hidden observed variables from the remaining addressed mesh state
masking.deployment: infer(given, targets) uses the same mesh writer and reader
